blocks.orig: Located at the foot of Mount Meru in Arusha, Ilboru Safari Lodge offers traditional Swahili-styled accommodation, combining cozy, rustic charm with modern comforts. Surrounded by 5 acres of ancient trees and lush greenery, you easily forget you’re so close to the city. The hotel is run by a Dutch family and has a lovely swimming pool, a pool bar, a wellness center and serene outdoor lounging spaces. The beautiful ensuite rooms and the on-site restaurant serving international and local cuisine make it a great place to start or finish your safari.
